improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try 3 free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace for business owners, traders, and professionals. Powered by Claude. Start with 3 free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: Search engines display the meta description in results, directly impacting click-through rates. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. The copy highlights Claude power, the free trial hook, and accessible pricing without inventing claims. This is foundational SEO that costs nothing but boosts organic visibility and social credibility.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant), who it's for (trade and business professionals), and the key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading includes a clear, low-friction CTA by highlighting the three free searches, reducing hesitation and driving trial engagement without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to your personal workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. It reassures visitors there's no surprise, clearly states the affordable entry price, highlights the annual savings, and reinforces the value they'll receive as members. This transparency builds trust and reduces drop-off at the paywall.
